verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no API or other programmatic way for an external agent to pull the cap table, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. What exists is manual Excel and Open Cap Table Format (OCF) report exports, plus an in-product AI Tie Out Assistant that compares legal documents to the cap table. These are adjacent features, not agent-driven programmatic retrieval and reconciliation against a data room.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent pull my current cap table programmatically and reconcile it against my data room before a financing
